summary: Tillicum Peak, Kaniksu NF: a patrol point said to serve Orwig Hump lookout. No source dates a structure on the summit.

facts.design: Patrol platform tower, per the Forest Lookouts index

evidence.supports: Site is in Pend Oreille County
Site is managed by the Kaniksu National Forest
Index describes the site as a patrol platform tower
Peak was said to be a patrol point for Orwig Hump Lookout
evidence.quote: The Tillicum Peak was said to be a patrol point for Orwig Hump Lookout.

evidence.supports: Tillicum site lies 2 miles to the northwest of Orwig Hump, said to be its patrol point
evidence.quote: The Tillicum Peak site 2 miles to the NW was also said to be a patrol point for Orwig Hump Lookout.

evidence.supports: Orwig Hump had a 15-foot tree platform in 1932
evidence.quote: In 1932, there was a 15-foot tree platform.

evidence.supports: Orwig Hump had a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab from 1934
evidence.quote: In 1934, a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab was built.

evidence.supports: No maps show anything at Tillicum Point; a trail has crossed the summit since at least 1932
evidence.quote: No maps show anything at Tillicum Point although a trail has crossed the summit since at least 1932.

evidence.supports: Tillicum Peak is over 400 feet higher than Orwig Hump and would have blocked its view
evidence.quote: Tillicum Peak is over 400 feet higher than Orwig Hump and would have blocked much of the view for Orwig Hump.

evidence.supports: Willhite had not yet visited the site
evidence.quote: Hiking Distance: Have not visited yet

evidence.supports: Current Forest Service map shows a trail between Tillicum and Orwig Hump
evidence.quote: Current Forest Service map shows trail between the two

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts index calls the site a patrol platform tower. Willhite calls it a patrol point for Orwig Hump, with no structure described. The story reports both and does not claim a structure stood on the summit.

notes_for_editor: Almost all of the history is second-hand. The patrol-point link comes from Willhite, who has not visited the site, and the index's 'patrol platform tower' is a type label with no date. No source dates a structure at Tillicum Peak, so no build or removal event is recorded. The brief's status and kind stay unknown. The Kaniksu National Forest name comes from the Forest Lookouts index only. Willhite's 1932 to 1961 history belongs to Orwig Hump and is used only as context for the patrol link.
